body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and make the target Distracted until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Move one unsecured small object held by the target into its space on a hit; not its weapon or signature equipment.
On a hit, the target cannot make movement Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Contingency - Ambush
rider.html: When the target next moves or retrieves an object before your next turn, you may move 1 unit around it and make it Exposed.
